summary: Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. filed a Form 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing that it filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for a proposed offering of newly issued Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036, and furnished an investor presentation. This is a routine shelf takedown of subordinated debt, not a special situation; no equity terms, price per share, or stakeholder changes are stated. The filing also references the company's prior merger with LINKBANCORP as background. No board recommendation, advisor mandate, or deal mechanics are disclosed, so the relevant watch item is pricing at launch.
